card.name: Last piece of drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name that is split into parts, such as the ending of enfuvirtide or amivantamab. It also fires inside brand names like KRYSTEXXA and in pramipexole.

modes.label: Antiviral name ending
modes.description: The ending 'ide' of enfuvirtide in lists of drugs that need no dose change.

modes.label: Antibody name ending
modes.description: The ending 'ab' of amivantamab given together with another drug.
modes.example: given in combination with amivantam<<ab>>. ( 2.2 ) Continue
